text: At 18.1 s ATC cleared Alaska 421 to climb and maintain one one thousand, and at 24.7 s the pilot monitoring read back one 1000. At 26.0 s the pilot flying set MCP 11000 and climbed, and the aircraft rose from 8980 through 9340 and 10420 to 10980 and 11230. Crosscheck stayed silent, which was right because the clearance, readback and setting agreed.
